name: durable-researcher
description: Self-hosted deep research agent with durable execution via Absurd, browser access via Steel, and LLM agent loop via Pi Agent SDK

scripts.db:init: ABSURD_DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/absurd} absurdctl schema-version 2>/dev/null && echo 'Schema already initialized' || ABSURD_DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/absurd} absurdctl init; ABSURD_DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/absurd} absurdctl create-queue default 2>/dev/null; echo 'Done'
